q1_issues.issue: The definite "the cauldron" is minted as a per-occurrence Skolem term (sk_cauldron $e) with its (Member (sk_cauldron $e) cauldron) typing placed inside the rule's conclusion, so the cauldron's existence is derived rather than presupposed; the whenever exemplar instead puts definite participants at top level as constants ("Every time the bell rings, the dog barks" emits (Member sk_bell_1 bell) and (Member sk_dog_1 dog) outside the rule), and a first-mention definite is specified to take a fresh symbol, not a Skolem function.

notes: The rest is right: bare "when P, Q" with an indefinite participant routes to the whenever rule, "a Keeper" stays a capitalized common noun with no Name atom, silken_thread fuses as a material adjective (so both genus and modifier atoms are due), and sea_water / mire_essence expose only their head genus. (Location $e sea_water) for a medium-denoting "in" is the listed role for that preposition and reads as licensed.
